feedback: Vincent's confession follows the strongest clue I identified: his wooden-model story conflicts with the physical bottle and card record. The explanation that he wanted the source to seem harmless makes that lie coherent, and his resentment of the patron's control has been present from his introduction. The comparison with Dada gives the ending a personal sting. The admission of the actual preview theft and glass transfer is new, but it confirms the proposed method rather than introducing a new scientific mechanism or inaccessible fact. Chip and Elle explain their competing lies credibly, although those explanations were not independently established before voting. The ending feels emotionally earned while leaving my concern about uniqueness of deduction intact.
